name: A Clue to Sanders' Treasure
summary: In Westfall, a weathered parchment carries the trail of notorious pirate Captain Sanders. It marks the second step in a treasure hunt across the bluffs and coastlines.

sections.title: A Pirate's Riddle
sections.body: After you follow Captain Sanders' first treasure map, you find a parchment that points farther inland into Westfall. The scrawled note sends you east from the coast, up the bluffs toward the main road. Near crumbling stone ruins and an abandoned chimney, an old barrel marks the next place Sanders hid a clue, drawing seekers deeper into the troubled farmlands.

aliases: what is a clue to sanders treasure
faq.answer: Captain Sanders left a handwritten note to guide anyone clever enough to follow his trail toward another hidden container in Westfall.
The clue sends you east from the coast and up the bluffs toward the Westfall road. An old barrel lies near a ruined chimney.
Captain Sanders was a pirate. His legacy survives in the treasure caches and riddles he hid across Westfall's shores and countryside.
